subject.title: feat(openai): support ChatGPT OAuth for Responses vision

question: Should Tachikoma officially support ChatGPT OAuth through the Codex Responses backend and persist rotated OAuth credentials as part of its public OpenAI-provider contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically focused and has live proof, but selecting a non-Platform backend and rewriting stored credentials defines a durable provider and upgrade contract that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the OAuth contract
options.body: Accept the Codex backend and credential persistence as supported behavior after confirming the documented compatibility expectations for embedding applications.

options.title: Require a narrower contract
options.body: Keep API-key behavior unchanged but narrow OAuth support or persistence until maintainers define the permanent credential-source and rotation policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the OAuth contract
recommendation.body: Accept the Codex backend and credential persistence as supported behavior after confirming the documented compatibility expectations for embedding applications.

likelyOwner.reason: Main-history ownership for the OpenAI provider and credential manager should decide the supported transport and persistence contract.
